semiconductor_relevance: High — Tei Solutions provides specialized equipment and services for semiconductor development, particularly in etching technologies and patterned wafers.
summary: Tei Solutions specializes in providing test and patterned wafers to support semiconductor development, along with precision etching technologies for silicon materials. They focus on TMAH wet etching equipment and offer evaluation services for various applications, including bio-diagnostics.
capabilities: Precision etching technologies for Si materials
